newsitem.title: LATVIA: IMF MISSION, SENIOR OFFICIAL TO VISIT LATVIA.
newsitem.headline: IMF MISSION, SENIOR OFFICIAL TO VISIT LATVIA.

text.p: A mission from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is to visit Latvia from July 16 to look at Latvia's fulfilment of existing agreements and to decide on future cooperation, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
On July 21, IMF deputy managing director Shigemitsu Sugisaki will also arrive in Latvia to meet Finance Minister Zile, Prime Minister Andris Shkele and central bank chief Einar Repshe.
Zile was quoted by the ministry as saying he hoped that Latvia would continue its five-year work with the IMF.
Latvia's latest agreement with the IMF runs out in August. The mission lasts until July 30.
Latvia's main agreement with the Fund is for a standby loan of some $48 million.
